name: prism

inventory.name: Resonant Orb
inventory.description:
✦ ✦ ✦ ✦ ✦ ✦

The orb sings. Not loudly — completely. Every bond in your ledger is in the note, and the note is in tune.

Grade: Crescendo — 4 front / 4 bench
The orb is whole, and it sings.

inventory.name: Old Dopo Robe
inventory.description: A robe worn by a commoner from a far-away land. Despite the look, it is quite formidable — and very easy to move in. Its threads remember a schoolyard where everyone held a wooden sword, and everyone won.

inventory.name: Beating Root
inventory.description: A knot of pale root that beats like a second heart. Held to a chest, it sinks in and takes root — opening a place that was not there before. (Consumed by one actor to unlock their third accessory slot.)

inventory.name: Chance and Choice +5
inventory.description: A coin, simple in one's eye. Flip it, and disaster strikes; flip it again, and you are blessed by the universe itself. Every strike is a wager — one that averages out to exactly nothing, and feels like everything.

inventory.name: Emberbloom
inventory.description: A flower that smoulders without ash. Its petals keep a forge-hot glow for days after picking.

inventory.name: Stormlily
inventory.description: A lily that hums before a storm. Sparks gather on its stamens like dew.

inventory.name: Celestial Sigil
inventory.description: A silver sigil recovered from the thirtieth depth of a dungeon. Its etched rings turn slowly, and its light always points north — toward Celestia, the city beneath the aurora.

accessory3.name: Piece of Relationship +5
accessory3.description: Broken pieces of a mirror... curious, you peer into it — it was you, but his journey was undoubtly different yet the same as yours. '...' One of you stares back. You can feel his grief as if you w-[REDACTED]

side_quests.name: Alice's Jabberwock
side_quests.desc: Alice has been counting sugar cubes at the Mad Hatter's table while a beast writes its own ending. She would like her story back.

objectives.label: Meet Alice at the Mad Hatter's tea party
Recruit Alice into your party
Defeat the Jabberwock (Floor 40)
Help Alice become a permanent ally

side_quests.name: Red Hood's New Ending
side_quests.desc: Red Hood came to Wonderland to write a new ending for her story. The Big Bad Wolf ate the old one — and he is still hungry.

objectives.label: Meet Red Hood at the Mad Hatter's tea party
Recruit Red Hood into your party
Defeat the Big Bad Wolf (Floor 20)
Help Red Hood become a permanent ally

side_quests.name: Dorothy's Way Home
side_quests.desc: Dorothy has walked the yellow brick road six times, and it never ends where she wants. To go home, she must first finish the Witch's story.

objectives.label: Meet Dorothy at the Mad Hatter's tea party
Recruit Dorothy into your party
Defeat the Wicked Witch of the West (Floor 30)
Help Dorothy become a permanent ally

side_quests.name: The Looking-Glass Road
side_quests.desc: Wonderland is reached through a book in Veilholt's Arcane Tower. Clear Floor 20 in two different biomes to unlock the Looking Glass Shard at Veilholt's Black Market (5,000g) — then open the book.

objectives.label: Clear Floor 20 in two different biomes
Hold a Looking Glass Shard (Veilholt Black Market)
Open the book in Veilholt's Arcane Tower
